# `gcp.regionalsecret`

A Regional Secret is a logical secret whose value and versions can be created and accessed within a region only.

[secretmanager](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | secretmanager |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `secretmanager.googleapis.com/Secret` |
| Hangs off | `projects` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: Paired with projects.locations.secrets through product_aliases and preferExactCollection: magic-modules keeps it in its own product, secretmanagerregional, whose base_url puts it on secretmanager.{{location}}.rep.googleapis.com. That host is checked against all 50 endpoints the Discovery document lists before the catalog carries it.
pre_delete (pre_delete/regional_secret.go.tmpl) is the same `deletion_protection` guard as the global secret's. pre_update (pre_update/secret_manager_regional_secret.go.tmpl) is only the `ttl`/`expireTime` half of the global one, with the same reasoning.
) |
| Mutation timeout | 60s |

## What it can do

| Operation | Supported | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Create | yes | `POST projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/secrets?secretId={{secret_id}}` |
| Read | yes | `GET projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/secrets/{{secret_id}}` |
| Update | yes | `PATCH projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/secrets/{{secret_id}}`, with an update mask naming the changed fields |
| Delete | yes | `DELETE projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/secrets/{{secret_id}}` |
| Import | yes | by id, see below |
